hewing_blade.name: Hewing Blade
hewing_blade.desc: A long blade of bog-iron, ground for clearing gorse off the fold walls. The Bearer's foster-father lent it for the voyage and said to bring it back. The grip is wrapped in his old belt.

maul.name: Post Maul
maul.desc: A round of split oak on an ash haft, bound with two iron rings, for driving fence posts. Hesk carries it from steading to steading and sells it when he is short. The leather on the grip is wrapped over an older wrap.

turf_spade.name: Turf Spade
turf_spade.desc: A peat-spade with a long narrow blade and one side wing, for cutting turf in strips. The ash handle has gone silver. It was wedged under a barrow door on the Kin-Mounds to hold the door up.

spear.name: Spear
spear.desc: An ash-hafted spear with a leaf head. Keeps the cold at arm's length and a little more.

greatblade.name: Greatblade
greatblade.desc: A two-handed blade as long as a door is tall. Swung, it makes its own weather.

bow.name: Bow
bow.desc: A short yew bow for fowling on the fells. Draws arrows from the quiver.

torch.name: Torch
torch.desc: A pitch-soaked brand. Holds back the dark; does nothing to the cold.
